task_title: Local A1111 sprite provider for icons/props

plan_review.notes: Adopted all review concerns: added singleVariantPrompt contract, provider capabilities for no-reference backends, local-a1111 type guard (weapon/item/tile/vfx only), deterministic guttered sheet assembly for slicer compatibility, model override_settings wiring, and integration coverage for reference-skip + sliceability.

code_review.notes: Shepherd code-review loop on PR #790 (bumped 2->3 apples: new ~330-LOC provider + factory wiring + two subtle correctness bugs). Round 1 = GitHub Copilot PR reviewer (7 concerns) all fixed in code: generation-loop grid iteration, multiple-of-8 cell dims, negativePrompt spelling, timeoutMs/steps docs, empty-cell test name, factory unit coverage. Round 2 = independent gpt-5.4 review found a real 'bad-grid' corruption bug (backend returning an oversized PNG bled across slots) - fixed with strict per-cell dimension validation + a defensive stitch clamp + a regression test. Round 3 = independent claude-sonnet-4.6 review: no substantive concerns. All 11 provider tests + 145 unit tests green.
